rules: No Inter for headings. Use Outfit for a sleek, technical look.
Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Overlines, Labels, and UI pane titles (e.g., 'TIMELINE', 'AI EDITOR') must be uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-xs, and text_secondary.
Mono font (JetBrains Mono) is strictly for timestamps, timeline rulers, JSON payloads, and timecodes.

layout.strategy: The 'Control Room' Grid - Dense, functional, edge-to-edge
structure: Top Bar: App logo, project title, global controls, and a high-contrast Export button.
Main Workspace (CSS Grid or Flex): Divides the screen into 3 vertical panels. Left (25%): Media/Transcript. Center (50%): Video Player Preview. Right (25%): AI Chat Editor.
Bottom Panel: Timeline stretching 100% width, fixed height (~250px), containing multi-track layers (Video, Audio, Captions) and a collapsible JSON Edit Plan visualizer.
layout.spacing: Tight padding (p-2 to p-4) within panels. 1px borders (border-zinc-800) separate panes instead of heavy shadows or gaps. Avoid rounded 'cards' inside the workspace; use edge-to-edge panes.

surfaces.panels: Solid #121214 background, sharp edges (rounded-none or max rounded-md). No glassmorphism on main editor panels to prevent visual distraction.
surfaces.buttons: Flat, sharp edges. Primary AI actions in Warning Yellow (#FFCC00) with black text. Destructive/Timeline actions in Signal Red (#FF3333).
surfaces.scrollbars: Must be customized to be ultra-slim or hidden (no gutter) to maintain the clean 'Control Room' aesthetic.

components.video_player: Center aligned, scalable to fit pane. Playback controls are minimal, floating over the bottom of the video or directly underneath. Use white/gray icons.
components.timeline: Horizontal scrolling. Tracks are stacked vertically with subtle alternating backgrounds (e.g., bg-zinc-900 / bg-zinc-950). The Playhead MUST be a striking 1px Signal Red line with a top triangle indicator.
components.ai_chat: User messages align right with a subtle #1E1E22 background. AI messages align left with a transparent background and a 2px left border in Warning Yellow.
components.transcript: Clickable timestamp blocks. Active word/sentence is highlighted in white, inactive text dimmed to text-zinc-500. Hover states should slightly lighten the text.
components.json_viewer: Collapsible panel. Syntax highlighted using JetBrains Mono. Background is pure #09090B to look like a terminal.

motion.ai_generation: Use a shimmering effect (linear-gradient moving mask) on text or a pulsing Warning Yellow border when AI is generating the edit plan.
motion.hover: Instant, functional color shifts on timeline clips and transcript lines. No floaty, slow animations.

icons.weight: fill for active states, regular/light for inactive. Keep them geometric and sharp.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark minimal background for video drop zone
Cinematic video frame for timeline clip or media library preview
User profile avatar for top nav or chat

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard JavaScript (.js/.jsx) for all frontend files, not TypeScript.
Use pure HTML/Tailwind CSS for the macro-layout (the 3 columns and bottom timeline) to maintain the edge-to-edge pro software look without rigid Shadcn constraints.
Customize Shadcn components (buttons, inputs) heavily to match the dark 'Control Room' aesthetic. Remove heavy rounding.
Install Google Fonts 'Outfit', 'IBM Plex Sans', and 'JetBrains Mono' and configure them in tailwind.config.js.
Global layout must be h-screen overflow-hidden, with individual panels handling their own overflow-y-auto to mimic desktop software.
Do NOT use purple or teal for primary actions. Stick to the provided Warning Yellow and Signal Red.
Mandatory: Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, chat inputs, transcript items, and timeline tracks for testing.
Do NOT use placeholders for images. Use the exact URLs provided in 'image_urls'.
